visual.description: Full-width dark background with centered headline text (two-tone: white + red/orange accent), centered subheadline, and a single centered CTA button, with a large app UI screenshot cropped at bottom edge bleeding into the next section.

A single wide app window mockup spanning roughly 80% of the viewport width, centered horizontally, split internally into a sidebar panel on the left (~25%) and a main content area on the right (~75%), with a secondary image panel visible at the far right edge.
Full-width section with a short centered paragraph of body text on a dark gradient background, no columns.
Two rows of four brand logos each (GitHub, Spotify, Google, Nvidia / CHE RRY, Zalando, Pinterest, EQT), centered and evenly distributed across the full width.

Left column (~40% width) contains a stacked vertical list of feature tab labels with a left blue accent bar on the active item; right column (~60% width) shows a tall mobile app screenshot on a solid blue background card.
Two equal-width feature cards side by side, each with a headline, subtext, and an app UI screenshot on a colored (blue / purple) background card.
Three equal-width feature columns each with a headline, body text, and a cropped app UI screenshot card, arranged in a single row.
Full-width section with a small icon/logo lockup and a large two-line headline left-aligned at ~10% from left edge, with no columns.
Three items centered horizontally: left laurel badge, central circular logo, right laurel badge, evenly spaced on a dark background.

A vertical stacked list of feature names centered on a dark background, with each item progressively fading from full white to near-invisible grey as it descends, suggesting a scroll-driven reveal animation.
A large centered multi-line quote in a pixel/retro font with individual letters colored in alternating red, orange, and purple hues, with a small source attribution below.

Three columns of testimonial cards in a masonry-style layout with varying card heights; cards have no border/card background—just text blocks with author name and source below, on the dark page background.
Footer divided into five columns: Company (split into two sub-columns of links), App, Use Cases, Social, and Updates (which contains a version changelog card), with a centered copyright line below.
